{{Quote|I come here often. It is my second home in the galaxy, but it is the first home of my heart.|[[Tenel Ka Djo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="YJKSA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>}}
The '''Singing Mountain''' was a mountain on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was the center of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]].

==Description==
The Singing Mountain was a volcanic mountain on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="TCoPL" /> The mountain and the surrounding area was located on a landmass bordered by a body of water to the north and a deep river canyon that bordered the [[Asou Dankal]] region to the west, the [[Takal Nax]] region to the south ans the [[Rhoa Yenth]] region to the east.<ref name="SWG:SM" /> The Singing Mountain also dominated the nearby [[Infinity Plain]].<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

[[File:Singing_Mountain_Clan_Stronghold.jpg|250px|left|thumb|The mountain seen from the [[Singing Mountain bridge|Witches' bridge]]]]
The mountain gave its name to the [[Singing Mountain Clan|clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir]] that inhabited the area. The witches had established their [[Singing Mountain Clan Village|village]] across the lower slopes of the mountain. The dwellings and work areas were arranged along natural terraces in the mountainside and in the valley, interspersed with orchards and open grounds used for gathering, training, and domestic activity. The village functioned in direct relationship to the [[Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold|fortress]], which dominated the landscape from its higher position on the flank of the mountain. Stone steps carved directly into the dark basalt of the mountain linked the village and the fortress. This approach formed the only easily access as all other faces of the mountain fell away in cliffs, shelves, and jagged crags. Together, the two formed a unified settlement, the village serving as the living base of the population and the fortress acting as the defensive, ceremonial, and political center.<ref name="TCoPL" />

[[File:SingingMountainSWG.jpg|220px|thumb|An aerial perspective of the Singing Mountain, displaying smaller villages towards the base, and the stronghold towards the summit]]
==Behind the scenes==
The Singing Mountain first appeared in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', written by [[Dave Wolverton]].<ref name="TCoPL" /> It later appeared as a playable location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
